propositions: Write-op inputs (force/reason/caused_by/ref/close_class) are hand-mirrored across three adapters (lib/CLI/MCP) with no mechanical guard against parameter drift or exposure gaps.

A durable pytest conformance oracle using a shared contract table executes each case against all three adapters against fresh temp stores and flags any divergence in ACCEPTED/REJECTED/PARAM_NOT_EXPOSED classification.

MCP gaps in force/reason/caused_by/ref exposure on transition/claim are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago; transition's coupled-force shape divergence vs. lib/CLI was addressed by blusterous-earthly-kitten landing before this oracle, so those rows pass normally with no xfail marker.

Adapter-bound internals (source/return_alias/_creation_channel/repo_root) are excluded from the contract and do not register as false divergences (verified by negative-control row and ADAPTER_BOUND_INTERNALS constant).

Runtime conditional rules (close_class required for bug-close, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) are asserted behaviorally on every adapter; divergent rejection is caught as a contract violation.

An in-suite simulated-parity fixture proves the oracle detects convergence: a mocked ConvergedMcpAdapter with param exposure flips a strict-xfail row to xpass, forcing marker removal to restore green.
